detail.longDescription: I`m trying to understand if my project really solves a good problem for someone. I have used Linux containers underneath instead of Docker cause it just felt more natural and applicable in my project`s case.. NxValue Stack enables you to deploy your private DNS node with PiHole/AdGuard Home and Unbound integrated inside an instance , and then has encrypted DoT/DoH endpoints that you can just paste inside your device. So it promises no setup work, no hardware config to go through, just deploy and use the endpoint on your device. The project is live at nxvalue.com , with a demo node available. Is this something that you may find interesting?
